`final class ObjModel`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IDrawableModel`](/reference/drawing/idrawablemodel/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.obj` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ObjModel.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/obj/ObjModel.java)

A 3D model read from a Wavefront .obj file, drawn with one texture.

## Description

Load it once and keep it in a field ([Load a model](/use/learn/going-further/3d-models/#load-a-model)); a model node or [`DrawModel`](/reference/drawing/drawmodel/) draws it.
The file is read at once, on the calling thread ([Know what JOID reads in a .obj file](/use/learn/going-further/3d-models/#know-what-joid-reads-in-a-obj-file)).

## Creation details

<a id="ObjModel-factory-of"></a>

### of

`ObjModel of(String name, Object handle, Resource texture)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Reads the model `name` from anything [`Asset.of`](/reference/resources/asset/#Asset-factory-of) accepts, as UTF-8 text, drawn with `texture`.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` that names the line when the file is malformed: a line that does not parse, an index out of range, or a group that mixes faces with and without texture coordinates.
Throws `UncheckedIOException` when the file cannot be read.
